C:P1.2.text: Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. We build, operate, and deliver fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy.

C:P1.3.text: Kinetic serves homes and businesses with ultra-fast, reliable internet solutions designed for today’s digital world. Visit kinetic to learn more.

C:P1.5.text: Welcome to the new Uniti — your premier fiber infrastructure provider.

C:P1.6.text: With the integration of Windstream, Uniti has emerged as a more powerful and agile company. With our national network, expanded services, and unwavering commitment to customers, we deliver world-class connectivity solutions. From custom enterprise networks spanning multiple locations to wholesale infrastructure that scales with your requirements, Uniti provides high-performance connectivity built for the future.

C:P1.8.text: With an industry-leading fiber backbone, Uniti Wholesale delivers greater reach, capacity, and redundancy.

C:P1.10.text: Uniti offers a robust suite of managed solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of modern businesses.

C:P1.12.text: Uniti delivers high-performance connectivity to businesses and government organizations nationwide.

C:P1.14.text: Kinetic serves homes and businesses with ultra-fast, reliable Internet solutions designed for today's digital world.

C:P1.15.text: Unmatched Network. Unrivaled Service. Future-Ready Connectivity.

C:P1.16.text: At Uniti, we are redefining what it means to be a fiber infrastructure provider. With a nationwide fiber footprint, cutting-edge technology, and a customer-first mindset, we are empowering businesses, communities, and individuals with seamless, secure, and scalable connectivity solutions.

C:P1.17.text: Our expanded network gives you access to one of America’s most extensive fiber footprints, connecting your business wherever you operate.

C:P1.18.text: We prioritize your business needs with expanded fiber access, industry-leading reliability, and a seamless customer experience.

C:P1.19.text: From connecting remote offices to delivering enterprise-grade managed solutions, we support your business goals of today and tomorrow.

C:P2.2.text: Shaping a future for every customer we serve.

C:P2.3.text: Our fiber connectivity solutions drive a new digital economy and enable success for all of our customers.

C:P2.4.text: Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States.

C:P2.5.text: With a steadfast commitment to customer service, operational excellence, and superior network capabilities, Uniti builds, operates and delivers critical fiber-based communications services to connect and empower people and businesses.

C:P2.6.text: Our brands offer a full suite of advanced infrastructure solutions:​

C:P2.7.text: We build customer-driven dark fiber infrastructure and provide tailored high-capacity wavelengths, ethernet and cell site backhaul leveraging our optical transport network for carriers, hyperscalers, government, and Fortune multiple customers across the U.S. and Canada.

C:P2.8.text: We build and operate fiber networks and provide transformative multi-Gigabit internet access to homes and businesses in small and medium-sized communities across the Southeast, Southwest, Northeast and Midwest U.S.
